name: free-new-desk
description: Windows 11 x64 desktop media platform with TVBox/FongMi-compatible source architecture.
author: cwe88108

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:desktop
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @free-new-desk/contracts && npm run build -w @free-new-desk/source-sdk && npm run build -w @free-new-desk/plugin-sdk && npm run build -w @free-new-desk/source-adapters && npm run build -w @free-new-desk/catvod-runtime-shim && npm run build -w @free-new-desk/tvbox-config && npm run build -w @free-new-desk/live-parser && npm run build -w @free-new-desk/epg-parser && npm run build -w @free-new-desk/data-service && npm run build -w @free-new-desk/proxy-service && npm run build -w @free-new-desk/spider-worker && npm run build -w @free-new-desk/plugin-host && npm run build -w @free-new-desk/jvm-spider-host && npm run build -w @free-new-desk/source-engine
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run build:desktop && node --test tests/unit/*.test.mjs tests/integration/*.test.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && node scripts/verify-renderer-build.mjs
scripts.package:win: npm run build && npm run prepare:runtime && electron-builder --win nsis portable --x64 --publish never
